# gardience_machine (Data Source)

Look up a machine: whether it has joined, its operating system and whether it is compliant (patched and on baseline).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gardience_machine" "web1" {
  name = "web-1"
}

output "web1_compliant" {
  value = data.gardience_machine.web1.compliant
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `compliant` (Boolean) Fully patched and on the security baseline (null until scanned).
- `key` (String) accepted, pending, rejected, denied or none
- `os` (String)
- `scanned` (Boolean)
